brief.prompt:
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail in PNG, landscape 16:9, 1672x941 or greater than 1000px width. Use case: illustration-story, final branded news thumbnail with integrated typesetting.

Approved art direction: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B energetic broad diagonal ink/brush strokes, ivory-white extremely bold Japanese typography, rough hand-drawn black/ivory ink illustration, selective dark burgundy and navy uniform accents and an orange basketball. A small number of strong elements. Clearly illustrative sports editorial art, absolutely not photorealistic. Do not copy the example thumbnail's Culver, score, names, date or shooting composition.

Article evidence, only these facts may inform copy: the fixed October 31, 2026 manuscript is a PRE-GAME preview about Kawasaki versus Yokohama BC, a Kanagawa derby, centered on the point guards Reoto Yonesu and Narito Namizato. Participation of both players is unconfirmed. The manuscript says its news information comes from search results, with official match details not directly confirmed. No scores, winning predictions, claims of playing, current performance, captaincy, or start time on the thumbnail.

Main subjects: TWO real players, Reoto Yonesu (米須玲音) and Narito Namizato (並里成), in an imagined energetic one-on-one basketball scene on the right 55% of the canvas. Yonesu on the center-right in a low moving dribble stance, upper body turning three-quarter toward viewer, one anatomically clear hand controlling an orange basketball near hip level; Namizato on the far right in a responsive defensive stance, face also clearly visible in three-quarter view, one arm out for defense. Show a plausible dynamic interaction, but NOT a recreation of an actual match or a claim these players appeared. No hoop, scoreboard, crowd, victory action or invented additional players. Keep limbs separated and readable. Upper thighs may crop at the illustration zone's lower edge; faces, hands and basketball fully inside canvas. Only ONE ball, as the player's prop. Not separate portrait headshots.

Likeness is essential, from the official 2026-27 club profile portraits examined:
Yonesu: youthful adult Japanese man; compact athletic guard build; short dense straight BLACK hair with neat slightly side-parted irregular fringe; clean shaven; straight thick eyebrows, dark almond eyes, straight nose, defined oval/angular face with full lower lip, focused expression. Burgundy basketball jersey with simple dark neckline, NO lettering, number, logos or sponsor marks.
Namizato: older adult Japanese man, slightly shorter compact athletic guard; short wavy/curly brown hair with lighter highlighted tips, pushed away from forehead; high forehead, defined arched dark eyebrows, narrow smiling eyes, pronounced cheekbones; distinctive thin moustache and separate small pointed chin goatee; longer tapered face. Focused alert expression with his characteristic facial structure. Navy basketball jersey with simple white/red edge trim, NO lettering, number, logos or sponsor marks. Distinguish the faces carefully rather than drawing two generic men.
Official reference portraits were visually inspected, for likeness only, never paste or reproduce official photographs:
https://kawasaki-bravethunders.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1787897526/files/user/_/team/players/2026-2027/11.jpg
https://b-corsairs.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1788768680/files/user/team/2026-27/33_NAMIZATO.jpg

Layout: left 45% is clean typography with generous readable negative space, right 55% holds the two active player illustrations backed by lime brushwork. Thin footer zone across full width on a clean dark background keeps qualifier text readable; never cover it with artwork. About 4% outer margins.
Exact typography, render every character correctly:
Top-left small white brand: "バスケまとめ"
Near brand small date: "2026.10.31"
Main headline left, huge bold lime, split across TWO lines:
"神奈川"
"ダービー"
Below headline, large bold white: "川崎 × 横浜BC"
Under it, medium bold white: "司令塔対決"
Near lower left, clearly readable white with lime accent rule: "試合前プレビュー／出場未確認"
Footer first line smaller but legible white: "本文は検索結果ベース・公式詳細未確認"
Footer second line white, not faint: "イラスト（AI生成）／イメージ"

Maintain strong visual hierarchy and excellent Japanese typography. No other text. No player names on the image. Do not add team/league logos, uniform branding, watermarks, official photos, scores, invented facts, sponsor words or photorealistic photographic textures. The footer explicitly identifies this as an illustrative image and not a documented play. Finished professional thumbnail, one image only.
